method.paired_cadence_rule: finite TIME, SAP_FLUX and PDCSAP_FLUX on the same cadence
method.normalization: separate full-selected-series median for each flux column

knn.reference_pool: labelled training partition from pinned catalogue snapshot
knn.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on log-transformed labelled training references
knn.host_exclusion: exclude query host; also exclude query KOI itself

limitations: Single Q4 product per KOI; not a multi-quarter or leave-one-quarter-out analysis.
Windowed median is descriptive and is not a transit-model fit.
SAP may retain long-term instrumental trends; no detrending is applied.
Only koi_depth is replaced; the other seven catalogue features remain fixed.
A ranking change is not evidence for or against planetary status.

ephemeris_provenance.query: select kepoi_name,kepid,koi_disposition,koi_pdisposition,koi_vet_date,koi_disp_prov,koi_period,koi_period_err1,koi_period_err2,koi_time0bk,koi_time0bk_err1,koi_time0bk_err2,koi_duration,koi_duration_err1,koi_duration_err2 from cumulative where kepoi_name in ('K00115.03','K02961.01')

comparison.sap_depth_assessment_reason: Visual inspection of the shared-axis time series and phase fold shows large coherent variation; normalized SAP MAD is 6.46x PDCSAP in transit and 6.56x out of transit. No detrending was applied, so the SAP depth and its KNN ranking are diagnostic only.
comparison.interpretation: Descriptive windowed-median statistic, not a transit-model fit.
